description:
Deployer launch history from CurveCall's hourly launch-outcome index on
Base, Robinhood Chain and Arc (built since 2026-09-24): every launch this
deployer made and how it ended (survived, rugged, died), with rug rate and
dev-behavior flags (dev moved tokens, relaunch count). Answers 'has this
deployer rugged before?' $0.01 USDC. Data by GeckoTerminal.
